propertySets.name: Pset_CableSegmentTypeFiberTubeSegment
propertySets.definition: Properties of Fiber tubes segments. This property set is applicable to a type or occurrence of IfcCableSegment with predefined type FIBERTUBESEGMENT.

properties.name: FiberTubeColour
properties.definition: Indicates the colour of a single fiber tube.

properties.name: NumberOfFibers
properties.definition: Indicates the number of fibers in the single tube or cable.
